instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Diagnostic imaging center network with 12 locations offering MRI, CT, ultrasound, and X-ray services. Processing 80,000 exams per year. Radiologist team of 25 reading remotely across subspecialties. We operate across multiple geographies and business units with a matrix organizational structure. A centralized digital transformation office coordinates innovation initiatives, but business unit autonomy means adoption varies significantly.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully deployed a new CRM system across the sales team 18 months ago, which improved lead tracking and reduced pipeline data entry time by 30%. The implementation was well-planned with dedicated project management and training. Building on this success, we are now exploring marketing automation integration and AI-assisted lead scoring.
answers.strategicGoals: We are heavily dependent on a single product category and a concentrated customer base—our top 3 clients represent 55% of revenue. This concentration risk is unacceptable for our long-term health. We need to identify and develop new revenue streams, possibly including new product lines for different customer segments or entirely new business models that leverage our existing capabilities.
answers.additionalContext: Vertex Ventures is currently facing intense competition from large integrated health systems and nimble vertical AI startups. Success hinges on rapidly pivoting resources to non-core service areas.
answers.teamSize: We have a corporate innovation division with 50+ staff spanning research scientists, engineers, designers, and strategy professionals. The division manages a portfolio of 15 active innovation projects at various maturity stages, from early-stage research collaborations with universities to near-commercialization products. Annual innovation budget is managed through a formal portfolio governance process with stage-gate funding decisions.

opportunities.title: Advanced AI Integration for Personalized Oncology Diagnostics
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging existing radiologist-in-the-loop workflows to develop highly specialized deep learning models focused solely on oncology imaging (mammography, lung nodules). This builds upon current work and increases service precision within the core competency.

first_actions: Identify 3 high-value oncology patient cases for model training in Q2
Allocate dedicated data scientist resources to partner with internal clinical specialists
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 92% AUC in the specialized oncology detection model within 6 months.

opportunities.title: Establish a Diagnostic Data Marketplace Platform
opportunities.rationale: Diversification of revenue by monetizing anonymized, aggregated imaging data through a secure B2B marketplace accessible to third-party startups and research institutions. This shifts the company from service provider to data enabler.

first_actions: Form a legal entity/partnership for data governance framework
Develop MVP of an anonymization and API gateway infrastructure
resources_needed: Legal counsel specializing in health data ($100k)
execution_plan.success_metric: Secure 5 paying third-party data partners within the first year.
milestones: M3: Achieve $50k in recurring data licensing revenue by Year End

opportunities.title: Develop a Remote Clinical Trial & Consultation SaaS Module
opportunities.rationale: Radically diversify into a new business model by offering remote, AI-monitored clinical consultation and trial management services to smaller clinics globally. This capitalizes on existing remote radiologist talent and addresses the need for diversification.

first_actions: Create a dedicated cross-functional 'SaaS spin-off' team
Pilot service in one specific subspecialty (e.g., cardiac imaging) in Q1
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 1,000 monthly active users for the SaaS module by Year 2.
milestones: M1: Core platform developed and validated
M2: Pilot launched in target geography (Q3)

next_steps.action: Conduct comprehensive market segmentation and competitor analysis focused on adjacent diagnostic services outside MRI/CT.
Formalize the 'Data Marketplace' radical project into a dedicated venture arm, including initial seed funding pitch preparation.
Audit internal talent pool for skills gaps required to support remote SaaS development and data governance compliance.

key_weaknesses: High dependency on a single product category (diagnostic imaging)
Fragmented adoption of innovation across autonomous business units due to matrix structure
Cultural resistance to high-risk, radical projects by established operational teams
Limited specialized talent pool in advanced AI and scalable SaaS development
